sloka: अपगच्छत नश्यध्वं सीतामाप स राघवः ।घातयेत् परमामर्षी सर्वैः सार्धं हि राक्षसैः ।। ५.२७.३९।।।।
transliteration: apagacchata naśyadhvaṁ sītāmāpa sa rāghavaḥ ।ghātayet paramāmarṣī sarvaiḥ sārdhaṁ hi rākṣasaiḥ ।। 5.27.39।।।।

translations.english: "(Therefore) go away from here. You will be totally destroyed by Rama who will secure his wife and will kill all of you along with others in great anger.
